translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: EFESIOS
book.title: An u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic ti Efeso c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pablo

content: In uchbil axi pel in tsacamil a Dios
Cum tata’chic pel ti ichich hual tsacamil a Dios, ca lej luba’ ca baju ejtil in ey jaja’.

Quit c’anithomatstechic jant’ini’ ti c’anithom a Cristo. Cum lej c’anithom im bina’ tim ba’ ca tsemets c’al huahua’ i hualab ejtil ti bina ca tsemtha ti jayq’ui’ i corderochic c’al in hualab an Israelchic. Tam ti tsemets a Cristo ti al an cruz, jilc’on a Dios lej culbel ejtil max ts’acchinchat c’al jant’o lej nihuihuil.
Hua’ats i uxumbechic ani i inicbechic. Hua’ats i jaylomchic c’al jahua’ pel in c’al in at inic. Cum tata’chic pelits ti c’al a Dios, ma yab in tomnal ca t’iloxna’ in quithab t’ajbilchic.
Yab quit at’ax cahuinchic ani yab quit macu’ cahuin. Yab quit c’atsub cahuin cum yab in tomnal ani’. Más in tomnal ca eyentha’ a hui’ abal ca bina’ i c’ac’namal yan c’al a Dios.

Hua’ats jita’chic in lej ujnal ti uxumbe ani hua’ats jita’chic in lej ujnal ti inicbe. Hua’ats jita’chic in ujnal quin t’aja’ jahua’ hualim quithab. Hua’ats axi lej jaylomchic c’al jahua’ pel in c’al in at inic, ani a Dios in tsu’talchic ejtil max in diosnal i c’alab axi teje’ tsabal. A lej alhua’ tso’obitschic abal patal axi antsana’ in ujnal quin t’aja’, yab ne’ets ca otsits ti eb jun tin t’ajal a Dios ani a Cristo ti lej Ts’ale.

Ca lej t’aja’ ti cuenta abal ni jita’ yab ti c’ambiychic max quin ulu nix yab pel i hualabtalab. Jitats quin t’aja’ antsana’ nixe’ xi hualbith t’ajbilab pel i jec’omma’ c’al a Dios, ani ne’ets ca lej yajchiquiyat c’al jaja’.
Tata’chic tit belom ni hue’ yab ca bina’ ta ba’ quit juncun c’al jaja’chic.

Ti jayq’ui’ tam it xe’tsinchic al i hualabtalab a yic’utsitsith xe’tsinthamal a ichich, ani xo’ a tajc’ac’ath xe’tsinthal cum ti pithamalchic an Ajatic in tajax ta ichich. Jats ca lej junini’ eynanchichic.
Max chubax ca eynanchi, ne’ets ca t’aja’ jahua’ alhua’, ani jahua’ chubax, ani jahua’ bolith.
Ca alhua’ eynanchichic ani ca lej lububuy ca tajax tso’obnanchi jahua’ pel in culbetal an Ajatic ca t’ajchi.

Cum ni jant’o ti alhua’ tin tamet a Dios in t’ajbilchic ax in yic’utsitsith xe’tsinthal in ichich, ni hue’ yab ca bina’chic a ichich quit juncun c’al jaja’chic. Expith ca t’aja’ jahua’ alhua’, ani antsana’ jaja’chic quin tajax tso’obna’ abal quithab in t’ajbilchic.
Ni yab ca t’iloxnanchi in t’ajbilchic, cum pel i tithetalab ca t’iloxnanchat jahua’ jaja’chic in tsinat t’ajal.
Ne’ets ca tejhua’methanchat in t’ajbilchic, cum in tajax a Cristo in tala’ tajc’ac’ayal ju’tamits ca c’uajba.
Jaxtam hua’ats i cau ax tu uchalac a Dios antse’:

content.text: A Cristo ne’ets ti pitha’ in tajax ta ichich.

content: Jaxtam ca lej alhua’ t’aja’chic ti cuenta ca xe’tsintha’ a ichich tsalpathmethanchithits c’al an Ajatic ani yab quit xe’tsin ejtil axi macu’ in tsalap.
Ca tsemanchichic ca ets’ey t’ajpichiquiy jahua’ alhua’, cum hua’ats yan jita’chic xe’ets lej t’ajpipil c’al jahua’ yab alhua’.
Ca luba’chic ca alhua’ tso’obnanchi jahua’ pel in culbetal an Ajatic ca t’ajchi, ani yab ca macu’ xe’tsintha’ a ichich tin cuenta in culbetal jaja’.
Yab ca hualca’ ta ba’chic quit uts’alin yab quit q’uibetha. Expith ca bina’chic a ichich ca jum putat co’onchat c’al an Espíritu Santo.

Tam quit t’ilmats c’al a at belom ca t’iloxnanchichic i salmo. Ca ajatnanchichic i t’ocat ajatlab abal ca canatbethanchat in ejattalchic. C’al patal a ichich ca ajatnanchi ani ca puhuethanchi im bij an Ajatic.
Ets’ey ca bina’chic i c’ac’namal yan c’al i Tata Dios tim bij i Ajatic Jesucristo c’al patal jahuaquits ti pithal ani ti t’ajchal.
In uchbil axi pel i tomquilab
Ca bina’ ta ba’chic tit at belom ca putu c’al a uchbil jun c’al xi jun c’al i c’ac’naxtalab ta ichich tin tamet a Dios.
Max it tomquith uxum ca tala’ putu c’al a uchbil c’al a q’uimathil, cum jats in culbetal an Ajatic.

In ey an tomquith inic pel i oc’lec c’al in q’uimathil ejtil a Cristo jaye pel i Oc’lec c’al im bichohuil. Ani im bichohuil ja’its pel ejtil in inictal a Cristo, ani jaja’ ja’its pel i Jec’onthax c’al im bichohuil.

Jant’ini’ im bichohuil a Cristo in cua’al in uchbil quin tala’ putu jahuats ta ca abatna c’al jaja’, antsana’ an tomquith uxum jaye in cua’al in uchbil quin tala’ putu jahuats ta ca abatna c’al in q’uimathil.
Max it tomquith inic ca ichich hual c’anitha’ a q’uimathil ejtil a Cristo jaye ichich hual c’anithom c’al im bichohuil. Ma im bina’ tim ba’ ca tsemets ti al an cruz ti calchix c’al im bichohuil.
Jats tin t’aja’ abal quin t’oquethanchi in ichich jitats ca otsits tim bichohuil jaja’. In t’oquethanchal c’al in cahuintal ani ejtil max c’al i ja’.

Jaxtam a Cristo in tsu’tal im bichohuil lej alabel. Pel ejtil i uxum tomquinel alabel ts’ejcath in toltomil yab xenqueth ani yab xuts’bath. In tsu’tal lej huinat t’oquethachits ani yabats mucuth c’al i hualabtalab.
An tomquith inic quin ichich hual c’anitha’ in q’uimathil ejtil max in c’anithal in cuete’ inictal. Max quin c’anitha’ in q’uimathil, jun t’ajat in cuete’ c’anithal tim ba’ jaye.
Yab hua’ats i inic quim pojca’ in cuete’ inictal. Im pijchal ani in alhua’ beletnal. Antsana’ a Cristo in alhua’ beletnal im bichohuil.
In alhua’ beletnal xe’ cum pelits ejtil in inictal jaye. Huahua’ tu belom ejtil max pel tu anam t’u’ul ani pel tu beclac a Cristo.
Jitats quin jila’ in tata ani in mim ani ca tomquin c’al i uxum u jumbelits c’al axi tsabaccua’. Ani chubax.
Lej luputh axe’ xi cau jahua’ in ulumal a Dios abal ne’ets ca jumbe c’al axi tsabac. Pel i t’ipchixtalab c’al a Cristo ani c’al jitats quim bela’ jaja’. U jumbelits c’al axi tsabac jaye.

Jaye pel i cau abal tata’chic ax it tomquith. Max it tomquith inic ca ichich hual c’anitha’ a q’uimathil ejtil max a cuete’ c’anithal ta ba’, ani max pel it tomquith uxum a cua’al a uchbil ca c’ac’na’ a q’uimathil.
